newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Cimpor rises on Q1 hopes.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Cimpor rises on Q1 hopes.

text.p: Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal gained nearly two percent to 3,844 escudos, far outpacing the overall market, after the company announced it would post first quarter results after the market's close on Thursday, traders said.
Traders said that the stock was being boosted on expectations for some good numbers although analysts declined to make any specific predictions.
The construction industry association has said that cement sales rose over 20 percent year-on-year in the first quarter of 1997.
"I am expecting a strong (profit) figure, even if the numbers could again be affected by the revaluation of assets (carried out in 1996)," said one London analyst who asked not to be named.
